title: Orchid Pavilion Preface (Lanting xu)
summary: The calligrapher Wang Xizhi and about forty friends and family gathered in 353 CE at his Orchid Pavilion retreat, ten kilometres from Kuaiji (modern Shaoxing). Thirty-seven poems were collected and Wang wrote a celebrated preface of 324 characters in twenty-eight lines. The original is lost.

uncertainty.note: Gathering on the third day of the third lunar month (April 22) 353; EBSCO dates the preface "after 353".

as_recorded.value: third day of the third lunar month of 353 C.E.

where.modern_name: near Shaoxing, Zhejiang, China (proxy: city-level pin; pavilion is about ten km from Kuaiji)

importance.justification: Regarded as one of Wang Xizhi's greatest accomplishments and a landmark of Chinese calligraphy.
